title: Sign in and reach the dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can submit valid login credentials and land on the main dashboard successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email or operator code field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the main dashboard is displayed
Verify factory summary metrics are displayed

title: Review factory metrics from the dashboard
description: This verifies that an operator can open the main dashboard and view the key factory metrics needed at the start of a session.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify factory output metrics are displayed
Verify active loom count, efficiency, and payout totals are displayed

title: Map spreadsheet columns and complete an import
description: This verifies that a user can map spreadsheet columns correctly and successfully start the import process.

steps.description: Navigate to /excel/import
Select a valid spreadsheet file for import
Map the required spreadsheet columns to the matching database fields
Start the import
Verify import processing results are displayed
Verify imported records are shown as processed

title: Submit a shift production entry
description: This verifies that a supervisor or weaver can create a shift production record and see a successful submission outcome.

steps.description: Navigate to /production/entry
Fill in the shift production form with valid values
Submit the production entry form
Verify a successful submission confirmation is visible
Verify the production entry is recorded in the UI

title: Log a valid production shift entry
description: This verifies that a user can submit a complete shift production record and see it recorded successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /production/entry
Select a worker
Select a loom
Fill a valid meters produced value into the production field
Fill a valid defect count into the defects field
Submit the shift report
Verify the recorded production entry is displayed
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Review key factory metrics on the dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can open the main dashboard and see the core factory metrics needed for daily oversight.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify total output metrics are displayed
Verify active loom count is displayed
Verify efficiency summary is displayed

title: Approve payouts after reviewing earnings
description: This verifies that a user can complete the payout approval flow after reviewing worker earnings and see the approved payout state.

steps.description: Navigate to /payouts
Filter payout statements by pay period
Review the worker earnings details
Trigger the payout approval flow
Verify the payout state indicates approval
Verify an approval confirmation is visible

title: Fix missing column mappings before importing
description: This verifies that a user can detect incomplete mappings, correct them, and then proceed with the import successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /excel/import
Select a valid spreadsheet file for import
Leave at least one required column unmapped
Verify a column mapping error is displayed
Correct the missing column mapping
Start the import
Verify import processing results are displayed

title: Export payout summary and complete approval
description: This verifies that a payroll user can review the payout summary, export it, and complete the approval flow successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /payouts
Review the payout summary for the current pay period
Export the payout summary
Approve the payout run
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the payout approval state is updated

title: Import spreadsheet data with correct column mapping
description: This verifies that an admin or user can map spreadsheet columns correctly and complete a bulk import successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /excel/import
Upload a valid Excel or CSV file
Map the required columns correctly
Start the import
Verify the import completes successfully
Verify imported records are displayed

title: Review payout summary by pay period
description: This verifies that a payroll user can open payouts and filter the summary to the desired pay period.

steps.description: Navigate to /payouts
Select a pay period filter
Verify worker payout summaries are displayed
Verify itemized earnings are displayed

title: Import production records from a spreadsheet with correct mapping
description: This verifies that a user can map spreadsheet columns correctly and complete a successful batch import of production or attendance records.

steps.description: Navigate to /excel/import
Select a spreadsheet source for import
Map the required columns correctly
Start the import
Verify the imported records are displayed
Verify a successful import confirmation is visible

title: Upload a spreadsheet for bulk import
description: This verifies that a user can start an Excel or CSV bulk import by selecting a spreadsheet and reaching the mapping stage.

steps.description: Navigate to /excel/import
Select a valid spreadsheet file for import
Verify the column mapping interface is displayed
Verify the uploaded file is recognized for import

title: Filter looms by operating status
description: This verifies that a supervisor can switch loom status views and see the floor monitoring results update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /production
Filter the looms to show active machines
Filter the looms to show idle machines
Filter the looms to show maintenance machines
Verify the loom monitoring results are displayed
Verify the status-filtered loom list is displayed

title: Review payout statements for a pay period
description: This verifies that a user can filter payout statements by pay period and view the itemized earnings breakdown.

steps.description: Navigate to /payouts
Filter payout statements by pay period
Review the worker earnings details
Verify itemized earnings are displayed
Verify payout statements for the selected pay period are shown

title: Export a payout summary after reviewing it
description: This verifies that a user can export the currently reviewed payout summary from the payouts screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /payouts
Filter payout statements by pay period
Export the payout summary
Verify an export confirmation is visible
Verify the payout summary remains available on the page

title: Import records from a CSV file
description: This verifies that a user can use a CSV spreadsheet source and reach successful import results through the same bulk import workflow.

steps.description: Navigate to /excel/import
Select a valid CSV file for import
Map the required spreadsheet columns to the matching database fields
Start the import
Verify import processing results are displayed
Verify the imported records are displayed

title: Remember workstation before signing in
description: This verifies that enabling workstation persistence still allows a successful sign-in to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email or operator code field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Enable workstation persistence
Submit the login form
Verify the main dashboard is displayed
Verify the user can access the dashboard normally

title: View a worker's performance profile

steps.description: Navigate to /workers/W101
Verify the worker profile content is displayed
Verify production history and performance trend information are displayed

title: Show validation when production values are invalid
description: This verifies that invalid production input is rejected and validation feedback is shown instead of submitting the form.

Select a loom

Fill a valid defect count into the defects field
Submit the shift report
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the shift report is not recorded
